shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone face
animal or creature forms (A) vs human forms (B) — both living beings in profile
repeated figures aligned along a horizontal axis
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief figures in profile arranged along horizontal registers, but that is a generic convention: A shows schematic animals (quadrupeds, birds, a snake-like form) and abstract crouching figures stacked in bands with no interaction, while B shows two naturalistic bearded human figures in elaborate headgear and drapery, one turning to hold an object toward the other. The rendering conventions differ sharply — flat, outline-like schematic animal forms versus rounded, modelled human anatomy and detailed fabric folds — and no distinctive motif is shared.
